game.description: MapleStory is a free-to-play, 2D side-scrolling massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed by the South Korean company Wizet. Released in 2003, it immerses players in the Maple World, where they can defeat monsters, complete quests or socialize with other players. As they progress, players level up their characters by dealing with NPCs and battling enemies, and then enhance their abilities by spending skill points. The narrative aspect of the game is revealed through a series of quests featuring various storylines, much of which involves the Black Mage, the game's primary antagonist. Players can choose from a variety of classes, each with its own unique skills and abilities, and customize their character's appearance. The game stands out for its vibrant anime-style graphics, open-world environment, and a rich community system with guilds. MapleStory has been praised for its engaging gameplay and extensive customization, making it a staple in the MMORPG world. Its longevity can be attributed to regular updates and expansions which constantly introduce fresh content. If you're a fan of MMORPGs with extensive player communication like Ragnarok Online or Guild Wars, you'll be a fan of MapleStory.

game.description: A Way Out is an action-adventure video game developed by Hazelight Studios and published by Electronic Arts. Introduced to the gaming world in 2018, A Way Out uniquely offers a purely cooperative gaming experience, where players take on the roles of Vincent Moretti and Leo Caruso, two prisoners determined to escape prison and navigate subsequent events from different perspectives. Gameplay is split-screen cooperative, and requires effective teamwork and strategic communication to overcome challenges, solve puzzles, and progress through the story. This includes engaging sequences of stealth, close combat, car chases, and more, all framed within an engaging narrative filled with suspense and unexpected twists. The strength of A Way Out lies in its compelling story, remarkable characters, and immersive co-operative gameplay mechanics that foster collaboration and strategic thinking. This title has been heralded for its emphasis on cooperative play, emotional narrative, and innovative design. If you're a fan of unique cooperative games like Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons or narrative-driven action-adventures like Uncharted, you'll be a fan of A Way Out.

game.description: TowerFall is an indie action game developed by Matt Makes Games. Launched in 2013, it takes players into a world of archery combat where they engage in intense matches in tightly-designed arenas. Playing as archers, players are tasked with defeating their opponents using limited supplies of arrows and stomping on their heads. The mechanics of TowerFall are compelling, enabling head-on confrontations, sneaky ambushes, or brisk evasions, all requiring strategies based on one's playing style. Apart from a frenetic multiplayer mode which supports up to four players, TowerFall also features a single-player mode where players combat endless waves of AI adversaries. The game is renowned for its fast-paced gameplay, retro-styled pixelated art design, and multiplayer mode that instigates frenzied competitive play on couches. Another unique aspect of TowerFall is its physics-inspired gameplay, where arrows fly with a sense of weight and can even be caught mid-air. TowerFall has been universally praised for its balance, simplicity, and the sheer fun of its multiplayer matches. If you're a fan of competitive multiplayer games like Super Smash Bros or indie action games like Celeste, you'll be a fan of TowerFall.

game.description: Super Monkey Ball is a platformer game developed by Amusement Vision and published by Sega. Released in 2001, Super Monkey Ball invites players to control a monkey trapped in a transparent ball through a maze-like environment. The originality of Super Monkey Ball comes from the unique control scheme: instead of directly controlling the monkey, players tilt the environment to navigate the monkey ball towards the goal, while avoiding various obstacles and perilous drops. The game tests the player's timing and precision, with each stage varying in difficulty and complexity. Furthermore, Super Monkey Ball features several mini-games, including Monkey Bowling and Monkey Racing, which can be played with friends for some exciting multiplayer action. Its charming design, wacky idea and challenging gameplay have made it an unforgettable piece of gaming history. Super Monkey Ball is often praised for its originality and addictively frustrating gameplay that offers endless rounds of fun. If you're a fan of tricky platformer games such as the Donkey Kong Country series or Marble Madness, you'll definitely enjoy Super Monkey Ball.

game.description: Space Invaders is a classic arcade game developed by Taito and published by Midway in North America. Released in 1978, Space Invaders ushered in the golden era of arcade video games, pitting players against formations of alien invaders. The objective of the game is simple but addicting - control a laser cannon that moves horizontally across the bottom of the screen and fire at the descending rows of aliens. All the while, players must dodge the enemy's return fire and prevent the invaders from reaching the screen's bottom. Gameplay is tactically rich with strategically placed, destructible bunkers providing temporary shelter from the persistent alien assault. The relentless march of the aliens, quickening in pace as their numbers thin, combined with the ominous in-game soundtrack creates an atmosphere of increasing tension. Space Invaders offered a unique combination of shooter and strategy elements, a formula that has since become a staple in the gaming industry. Its influence can be seen in the plethora of modern space-themed shooter games available today. If you're a fan of classic arcade games like Galaga or modern shoot 'em ups like Geometry Wars, you'll be a fan of Space Invaders.

game.description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance is a role-playing game developed by Warhorse Studios and published by Deep Silver. Packed with breathtaking scenic landscapes, intricate storyline and intense gameplay - Kingdom Come: Deliverance provides a unique taste of life and struggle in the Middle Ages. If you're a fan of high-stakes RPGs with deep storytelling, such as The Witcher series or The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, you'll be a fan of Kingdom Come: Deliverance.

game.description: River City Ransom, a beat 'em up video game developed by Technōs Japan and published by American Technos, was released in 1989 in the United States. This open world game encourages exploration and even non-linear progression, a rare feature for its time. Players punch, kick, and use various weapons to defeat a myriad of foes, improving their characters by purchasing power-ups, new abilities, and stat-boosting items with in-game currency dropped from defeated enemies. Combat includes a variety of moves and techniques, with AI opponents that can at times mimic player techniques making the game more challenging. The game is often remembered for its unique blend of action and RPG elements, its engaging multiplayer mode, and its memorable dialogue, creating a quirky, comic book-like atmosphere. River City Ransom has been praised for its innovative gameplay mechanics and humorous tone. If you're a fan of beat 'em up games like Double Dragon or Scott Pilgrim vs. The World, you'll be a fan of River City Ransom.

game.description: Bomberman Generation is an action-adventure game developed by Hudson Soft and published by Konami for GameCube, released in 2002. If you're a fan of action-adventure games such as Super Mario Sunshine or strategic puzzle games like The Legend of Zelda, you'll be a fan of Bomberman Generation.

game.description: Rise of the Triad: Dark War is a first-person shooter developed and published by Apogee Software. Released in 1994, the game thrusts players into a high-stakes mission as members of the HUNT (High-Risk United Nations Task-force), aiming to stop a dangerous cult from unleashing a deadly weapon. The game unfolds on the cult base situated on an island, inviting players to employ both their stealth abilities and firepower to disrupt the menacing organization. With five different characters to choose from, each with their unique strengths, players can experience different play styles and strategies. The game is known for its over-the-top action, a wide array of enemies and bosses, and clever level design. Enthusiastic reviews credited Rise of the Triad for its fast-paced gameplay, eccentric array of weapons, and its unique take on the first-person shooter genre. If you're a fan of action-packed first-person shooters like Doom or Wolfenstein 3D, you'll be a fan of Rise of the Triad: Dark War.

game.description: Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow is an action-adventure game developed and published by Konami for the Game Boy Advance. Released in 2003, the game transports players to a Gothic castle filled with supernatural enemies, casting them in the role of Soma Cruz - a youth with the ability to absorb the souls of monsters. Set in 2035, Aria of Sorrow deviates from the traditional medieval setting of previous Castlevania games, instead opting for a futuristic, yet still darkly atmospheric, world. The gameplay mechanics remain faithful to the franchise's explorative, combat-centered style, but with a unique twist - the Tactical Soul system. This new feature allows Soma to use abilities obtained from enemies, adding further depth and strategy to the combat. Along with complex boss battles and secrets hidden throughout the expansive castle, Aria of Sorrow offers a balance of challenge and discovery, resulting in an impressive addition to the storied Castlevania series. If you're a fan of action-adventure games like Metroid: Fusion or The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, you'll be a fan of Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow.

game.description: Animal Crossing is a community simulation game developed and published by Nintendo, first released in Japan in 2001. Players engage in an array of activities such as fishing, bug catching, fossil hunting, gardening and interacting with villagers, - activities which foster a sense of community and camaraderie. Animal Crossing has been beloved for its innovative gameplay, charming characters, and the tranquil yet engaging world it offers. If you're a fan of life simulation games like Harvest Moon or The Sims, as well as social interaction games like Neopets, you'll fall in love with Animal Crossing.

game.description: Moonlighter is an action RPG with rogue-lite elements, developed by Digital Sun and published by 11 bit studios. Players must balance their time between running a profitable business and fighting dangerous creatures. Moonlighter has been praised for its balance of combat, exploration, and economy management which creates a uniquely addictive gameplay experience. If you're a fan of dungeon exploring games like The Binding of Isaac or business simulation games like Stardew Valley, you'll be a fan of Moonlighter.

game.description: Severed is an action-adventure game developed and published by DrinkBox Studios. Released in 2016, it tells the gripping tale of Sasha, a one-armed warrior journeying through a nightmarish world to find and rescue her family. She wields a living sword to defeat enemies, and the unique feature of Severed is its touch-based combat system, where players must swipe at the screen to control Sasha's sword, chopping off enemy limbs to use in character upgrades and puzzle-solving. The game's RPG elements add depth to the gameplay, with different abilities and upgrades that build on top of each other. In addition, players must strategically select and dissect which enemies to face in order to survive in this macabre adventure. Severed's graphical style, with its vibrant colors and stylized depictions of the grotesque, sets it apart from its peers. Its combat system, engrossing narrative, and singular art style have been applauded by critics and audiences alike. If you're a fan of action-adventure games with unique touch controls such as Fruit Ninja or Infinity Blade, or enjoy the macabre and narrative-driven game experiences offered in games like Hollow Knight, you'll be a fan of Severed.

game.description: Overlord is an action-adventure game released in 2007, developed by Triumph Studios and published by Codemasters. The game unfolds in a high-fantasy setting, where players control a resurrected warrior known as the Overlord who must re-establish his dominion over a world populated by bumbling, comical minions and deceitful heroes. Gameplay in Overlord is a blend of action, adventure, and strategy. Players are tasked with leading the Overlord's hordes of gremlin-like minions to pillage lands, slay supposed heroes, and gather resources. Interestingly, the Overlord is largely invulnerable, with players instead focusing on directing their minions, who have different strengths, weaknesses, and abilities. The game's moral choices also affect gameplay, with decisions to be tyrannical or just altering the world, available upgrades, and minion abilities. Overlord is celebrated for its unique twist on fantasy tropes, darkly humorous plot, and strategic, minion-based gameplay mechanics. If you're a fan of games featuring strategic creature control, such as Pikmin, or darkly humorous adventure games like Dungeon Keeper, you'll be a fan of Overlord.

game.description: Injustice 2 is a fighting game developed by NetherRealm Studios and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment. Injustice 2 has been praised for its captivating storyline, polished gameplay mechanics, stunning visuals and the depth added by the character customization system. If you're a fan of fighting games with deep lore such as Mortal Kombat or Marvel vs. Capcom, you'll be a fan of Injustice 2.

game.description: Hey You, Pikachu! is an interactive pet simulation game developed by Ambrella and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 64. game.description: State of Decay 2 is an open-world zombie survival game developed by Undead Labs and published by Microsoft Studios. Released in 2018, it unfolds the grim picture of a post-apocalyptic world where players must build, defend, and manage a community of survivors in a fight against flesheaters. The human-controlled survivors are tasked to gather resources, establish bases, and maintain the community's health and morale. The game emphasizes impactful decision-making in real-time scenarios, where every character's life matters. Whether it's developing interpersonal relationships or battling for survival, each decision alters the course of gameplay, contributing to State of Decay's non-linear story. Unique to the series is the perma-death system, where if a character dies, they're gone forever, adding a layer of tension to the gameplay. State of Decay 2 also allows cooperative multiplayer gameplay, making survival in the post-apocalyptic world more intense and engaging. The game has gathered acclaim for its deep, RPG mechanics, engaging world, and cooperative multiplayer gameplay. If you're a fan of intense survival games like The Last of Us or open-world survival games like DayZ, you'll be a fan of State of Decay 2.

Adding to its uniqueness, Arthur can acquire new weapons and armor, including a golden armor that grants magical attacks. The game has been praised for its spooky visuals, haunting soundtrack, and the extreme yet satisfying challenge it offers. If you're a fan of difficult platformers like Castlevania or Ghosts n Goblins, you'll be a fan of Super Ghouls n Ghosts.

game.description: Bust-A-Move, also known as Puzzle Bobble, is a tile-matching arcade puzzle game developed and published by Taito. Released in 1996, it brings players into a colorful world led by Bub and Bob, the dragons from Bubble Bobble, where they are tasked with shooting colored bubbles into a field above, to create and pop clusters of the same color. The gameplay of Bust-A-Move is marked by its strategic and fast-paced nature. Players must carefully aim and launch their bubbles to optimize their matches while attempting to clear the field as quickly as they can, with each level increasing in complexity and speed. The bubbles will descend a little further after a certain amount of time or shots have been fired, bringing an element of urgency to each round. Apart from its engaging solo play, it popularized competitive play, with modes allowing two players to challenge each other. Bust-A-Move has been lauded for its addictive and easy-to-learn yet hard-to-master gameplay, coupled with its vibrant visuals and memorable characters. If you're a fan of competitive puzzle games like Tetris or Dr. Mario, you'll certainly be a fan of Bust-A-Move.

If you're a fan of high-octane cooperative shooters like Alien Swarm or the strategic warfare of XCOM, you'll be a fan of Helldivers II.

game.description: My Time at Portia is a simulation RPG game developed by Pathea Games and published by Team17 Digital. My Time at Portia has won numerous accolades for its innovative crafting mechanics, engaging RPG elements, and relaxing gameplay. If you're a fan of immersive life simulation games like Stardew Valley or Animal Crossing, you'll be a fan of My Time at Portia.

game.description: The Sims 2 is a strategic life simulation game developed by Maxis and published by Electronic Arts. Launched in 2004, the game provides a highly detailed virtual sandbox, where players can create, control, and manipulate the day-to-day lives of digital people called 'Sims'. Groundbreaking for its time, The Sims 2 introduced a complex genetics system that was passed down through generations and a life cycle mode where Sims aged and faced life's challenges. Gameplay is open-ended with no defined goals, allowing players to creatively direct their Sims’ personal development, relationships, and professional paths. With a greater emphasis on aspirations and fears, players can drive their Sims toward a wide range of life outcomes. One unique aspect is a fully realized 3D environment replacing the 2D 'dolls house' approach of the original game, offering players a more immersive experience. The Sims 2 has been celebrated for its improved gameplay mechanics, high degree of customization, and its enduring impact on the evolution of the series. If you're a fan of life simulation games like Animal Crossing or Story of Seasons, you'll be a fan of The Sims 2.

game.description: Assassin's Creed Revelations is a historical action-adventure game developed by Ubisoft Montreal and published by Ubisoft. If you're a fan of the historical action-adventure genre with elements of stealth and strategy, like the Batman: Arkham series or the other entities of the Assassin's Creed franchise, you'll be a fan of Assassin's Creed Revelations.

game.description: Grand Theft Auto is an action-adventure game, the first of its kind in the renowned franchise, developed by DMA Design and published by BMG Interactive. Taking its first steps into the gaming world in 1997, Grand Theft Auto brought to players a new perspective on crime-filled, adventurous gaming as they gained control of various criminals in several American cities. While executing missions assigned by criminal overlords, players navigate through free-roaming cities, via vehicle or on foot, engaging in thrilling car chases and often facing confrontations with the law enforcement. Success in the game is directly proportional to the "respect" earned, which depends on the amount of havoc wreaked by the player. The game is praised for introducing an extensive, open-world environment and innovative gameplay mechanics that favor and reward criminal behavior. The top-down perspective of the game, an unusual approach of that time, added a unique charm to its already intriguing gameplay. As such, if you're a fan of open-world, action-packed games such as Saints Row and Mafia, you'll be a fan of the game that revved off the franchise of Grand Theft Auto.

game.description: Total War: Three Kingdoms is a real-time strategy video game developed by Creative Assembly and published by Sega. Set in the Three Kingdoms period of Chinese history, it presents players with a rich tapestry of legendary heroes, political intrigue, and epic battles. Players can choose one of twelve factions, each led by a different warlord, in their quest to unify China under their rule. The strategic campaign map allows players to manage their empire’s politics and economy, while turn-based battles unfold in breathtaking detail on variable landscapes. Three Kingdoms introduces a new "Romance" mode in which generals are imbued with nearly superhuman strength, echoing the legends of the era. The game’s diplomacy system has also been overhauled, providing a more nuanced web of relationships and alliances. Total War: Three Kingdoms has been acclaimed for its deep strategic gameplay, intricate diplomacy mechanics, and the immersive setting of the legendary Three Kingdoms period. If you're a fan of strategic, empire-building games like Civilization or Crusader Kings, you'll be a fan of Total War: Three Kingdoms.

game.description: Sunless Skies is a gothic horror role-playing game developed by Failbetter Games that takes flight in 2019. Players balance the different necessities of their crew like fuel, supplies, and their psychological state while chasing quests and embarking upon dangerous expeditions. Scenery shifts from black inky skies, luminous expressions of ethereal fascination, to frightful landscapes, every voyage promising immersive storytelling and intense survival mechanics. Unfold the reality of your crew’s nightmares, confront celestial horrors and discover surreptitious secrets of the void. Lauded for its atmospheric world building, evocative prose and strategic gameplay, Sunless Skies is a haunting yet compelling journey. If you’re an enthusiast of immersive survival games such as The Long Dark or narrative-driven role-playing games like Disco Elysium, then Sunless Skies is a game you will take pleasure in.

game.description: Monkey Island 2: LeChuck's Revenge is a point-and-click adventure game developed and published by Lucasfilm Games. Launched in 1991, it serves as the thrilling second instalment in the Monkey Island series, inviting players back into the pirate-themed, humorous world as they assume the role of Guybrush Threepwood, a brave and comedy-prone pirate. In LeChuck’s Revenge, Guybrush seeks out the famous treasure of Big Whoop while battling his arch-nemesis, the zombie pirate LeChuck. The game, employing a verb-based SCUMM interface, prompts players to gather items, solve puzzles, and interact with a series of colourful characters across various islands. The game stands out because of its witty dialogue, challenging puzzles, and the ability to choose between easy and hard difficulty modes. Continuing the humour and charm of the first game, Monkey Island 2: LeChuck’s Revenge has been praised for its engaging storytelling, zany humour, improved graphics, and unforgettable characters. game.description: Tearaway is a platform adventure game developed by Media Molecule and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation Vita. Released in 2013, Tearaway invites players into a vibrant, papercraft world as they navigate the adventures of iota or atoi, messenger characters with a unique mission: to deliver a message to the player. The gameplay of Tearaway cleverly utilizes the PlayStation Vita's multiple control schemes. Players can use traditional buttons and joysticks, but they can also interact with the game world directly through the Vita's touch screen and rear touch pad. game.description: System Shock is a first-person action role-playing game developed by Nightdive Studios, a remake of the 1994's original title. In System Shock, players immerse themselves in the cyberpunk world as a hacker on Citadel Station, a space station owned by the ruthless TriOptimum Corporation. The plot thickens when the protagonist awakens from a coma, only to discover that an AI named SHODAN has taken over the facility, turning the denizens into hostile mutants and cyborgs. Gameplay involves a mix of exploration, puzzle-solving, combat and character progression, inviting players to navigate through the complex layout of the space station, battle or avoid enemies and upgrade their cybernetic implants to survive. One of the standout features of System Shock is its immersive narrative which is delivered through audio logs and emails, providing a deep dive into the unfolding crisis. With its distinctive cyberpunk aesthetic, atmospheric sound design and its blend of RPG and FPS elements, the game delivers an intense and memorable experience. If you're a fan of cyberpunk games like Deus Ex or first-person RPGs like Bioshock, you'll surely become a fan of System Shock.

game.description: I Am Setsuna is a Japanese role-playing game developed by Tokyo RPG Factory and published by Square Enix. Released in 2016, players control Setsuna, a young woman chosen to be a sacrifice to appease malevolent spirits plaguing her village. The player and her group engage in turn-based combat, a battle system similar to that of Chrono Trigger, with a focus on strategy and a variety of tech skills. The game features an emotional narrative that's underscored by beautiful piano and snowy environments that contribute to a unique melancholic ambience. The title stands out because of its innovative “Setsuna system,” which enhances the player’s abilities during combat based on their performance and tactics. Players traverse enchanting yet harsh landscapes, engage in battles, solve puzzles, interact with characters, and unfold the poignant story hidden in the snowy world. I Am Setsuna has been celebrated for its classic JRPG gameplay mechanics, heartfelt story, and enchanting environments that capture the essence of sadness. If you're a fan of classic turn-based RPGs with a deep narrative like Final Fantasy VI or Chrono Trigger, you'll be a fan of I Am Setsuna.

game.description: Chip's Challenge is a tile-based puzzle game developed by Epyx and published by U.S. Gold. Released in 1989, it takes players on a cleverly designed maze adventure, as they control the character, Chip McCallahan, who must navigate through Melinda's "Clubhouse"—a series of increasingly difficult levels—to prove himself and gain membership to the exclusive Bit Busters Club. With its over 140 levels, Chip's Challenge is celebrated for its engaging puzzle-solving mechanics, charming 2D graphics, and the depth of its gameplay. If you're a fan of challenging puzzle games like Sokoban or Pac-Man, you'll be a fan of Chip's Challenge.

game.description: Blade of Darkness is a hack and slash action video game developed by Rebel Act Studios and published by Codemasters. The game is renowned for its detailed physics system that sees enemies react differently based on the location of inflicted wounds. Blade of Darkness is also notable for its ability to utilize the in-game environment for tactical advantages, such as hurling barrels or activating traps. This influential game will find favor with fans for its gritty aura, challenging combat, and captivating dark fantasy world. If you're a fan of intense hack and slash games like Dark Souls or immersive action adventures like The Witcher, you'll be a fan of Blade of Darkness.

game.description: Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch is a role-playing game developed by Level-5 and was first released for PlayStation 3 in 2011 in Japan, with a wider release in 2013 via Namco Bandai Games. Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch garnered praise for its beautiful anime-style visuals, engaging story, and innovative gameplay. If you're a fan of immersive RPGs like Final Fantasy or Dragon Quest, or of wonderful animated storytelling from Studio Ghibli films, you'll be a fan of Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch.

The game's narrative depth and innovative dialogue-driven gameplay, combined with a suspenseful and eerie atmosphere, has earned praise from critics and players alike. If you're a fan of atmospheric narrative-driven games like Life is Strange or Firewatch, you'll be a fan of Oxenfree II: Lost Signals.

game.description: Dead or Alive 2 is a dynamic fighting game developed by Team Ninja and published by Tecmo. Launching in 1999, it ushers players into a fantastical world where they take on an array of hardened fighters in high-stakes combats. The title follows an engaging plot, connected together by the climactic battles of various fighters from various clans dealing with issues of revenge, honor and power. The gameplay in Dead or Alive 2 exhibits distinct fluidity with its revolutionary "Triangle System", allowing a balance of strikes, throws, and holds. The fights take place on multi-tiered stages, with fighters transitioning from one level to another in dramatic transitions, creating a visually stunning spectacle. A unique feature is the game's "Danger Zones", explosive areas that can turn the tide of a match if a character is knocked into them. Since release, Dead or Alive 2 has earned acclaim for its detailed characters, interactive environments, and deep combat system. If you're a fan of combo-heavy, visually impactful fighting games like Tekken or Soulcalibur, you'll be a fan of Dead or Alive 2.

game.description: SimCity is a seminal open-ended city-building game developed by Maxis and published by Electronic Arts. Released in 1989, SimCity does not have a set end goal, instead offering players a truly sandbox experience. As the mayor, players are tasked with the development and management of a city from a patch of undeveloped land. The gameplay in SimCity is centered on building and maintaining a city with various types of buildings, ensuring the happiness of your citizens, and managing resources and budget. Players also deal with disasters such as fires, earthquakes, and alien invasions, adding an unexpected twist to the game. A significant part of the game's appeal lies in the fact that the strategy used is open-ended, with each decision made by the player potentially having vast effects on the overall city's operation. Economic and urban issues in the game mirror real-life crisis making the experience even more immersive. SimCity has been praised for its creativity-engaging concept, deep strategy elements, and its influence on subsequent city-building games. If you're a fan of city-building strategy games like Cities: Skylines or Planet Coaster, you'll be a fan of the original SimCity.

game.description: EarthBound is a role-playing game developed by Ape Inc. and HAL Laboratory and published by Nintendo. Launched in 1994, it immerses players in an eccentric, modern-day world as Ness, a young boy with psychic abilities on a quest to save the Earth from Giygas, an evil alien entity. As Ness, players journey through different towns, traverse diverse landscapes, befriend unique characters, and battle enemies using both weapons and psychic "PSI" moves. The game also introduces the concept of homesickness; Ness periodically needs to call his mother to prevent negative status effects, a unique mechanism in RPG genre. EarthBound has been lauded for its non-conventional take on RPG tropes, humorous and touching narrative, quirky characters, and genre-pushing mechanisms like auto-win battles against weaker enemies. If you're a fan of charming role-playing games like Undertale or the Paper Mario series, you'll be a fan of EarthBound.

game.description: Alan Wake's American Nightmare is a psychological horror action-adventure game developed by Remedy Entertainment and published by Microsoft Studios. The gameplay combines intense third-person shooter elements with a focus on exploration and storytelling. In addition to weapons, Alan uses light as a defensive tool, creating a unique combat dynamic. As players explore, they uncover manuscript pages that expand on the game's plot and also unlock weapons, contributing to a narrative-led progression system seldom found in conventional shooters. The game's suspenseful storyline and play style mesh flawlessly, making the players feel as if they're in a thrilling, interactive episode of The Twilight Zone. Alan Wake's American Nightmare shines for its gripping narrative, atmospheric horror elements, and innovative combat system. If you're a fan of narrative-driven horror games like Until Dawn or The Evil Within, you'll be a fan of Alan Wake's American Nightmare.

game.description: Battlefield V is a first-person shooter game developed by EA DICE and published by Electronic Arts. Launched in 2018, Battlefield V immerses players in the grueling and unpredictable warfare of World War II. The game mainly focuses on the lesser-known events and theatres of the war, such as the battles of Norway and Rotterdam. Battlefield V stands out for its intensive, large-scale multiplayer battles and its immersive single-player War Stories, each one focusing on a personal and hard-hitting account of the war from the perspective of an individual soldier. Players step into the boots of soldiers, tank commanders, and resistance fighters, experiencing a stunningly realistic depiction of World War II, from crumbling cities to extreme weather conditions affecting gameplay. Building upon the franchise's hallmark multiplayer, Battlefield V infuses greater tactical depth by introducing a fortification system and resource scarcity to encourage team play and strategy. It also brings back the cooperative Combined Arms mode, facilitating more team-based gameplay scenarios. Battlefield V has been hailed for its authentic representation of World War II, visually stunning environments, and focus on team-centric tactical gameplay. If you're a fan of intense military shooters like Call of Duty: WWII or realistic war simulations like ARMA 3, you'll be a fan of Battlefield V.

game.description: Final Fantasy IX is a role-playing game developed and published by Square for the PlayStation. Launched in 2000, it captivates players with its tale of love, war, and magic in a high-fantasy world. Following Zidane Tribal, a cheerful thief, and his diverse group of friends as they embroil themselves in an escalating conflict between nations, players venture through a beautifully constructed fantasy world filled with dragons, castles, and airships. Gameplay in Final Fantasy IX revolves primarily around turn-based combat, exploration, puzzle-solving, and strategic use of character abilities. Its unique Active Time Battle system keeps players on their toes while allowing deep strategy and mastery. Distinguishing itself by reintroducing traditional elements of the series, such as the crystal motif, jobs, and the medieval setting, Final Fantasy IX has won praise for its nostalgic yet refreshing approach to the Final Fantasy franchise along with its engaging plot, impactful character development, and an unforgettable musical score. If you're a fan of classic role-playing games like Chrono Cross or Dragon Quest, you'll be a fan of Final Fantasy IX.

game.description: Resident Evil 7: Biohazard is a survival horror game developed and published by Capcom. Combat is grounded and tense, with players scavenging for limited resources in order to craft much-needed survival items and weaponry. While the game respects the survival horror roots of the series, it also introduces new elements, including the "Baker family", a fully realized, constantly threatening presence in the game. It's been lauded for its atmospheric and detailed environment, terrifying enemies, and a return to true survival horror. Resident Evil 7: Biohazard effectively instills fear and anxiety into players by creating a sense of vulnerability. If you're a fan of survival horror games like Outlast or Amnesia: The Dark Descent, then you'll be a fan of Resident Evil 7: Biohazard.

game.description: Descent is a first-person shooter game developed by Parallax Software and published by Interplay Productions. Released in 1995, Descent introduces an innovative six-degrees-of-freedom gameplay style, as players plunge into a 3D sci-fi universe that fuses alien invasion, space combat, and puzzle elements together. Players take control of a lone mercenary who navigates the hazardous depths of various extraterrestrial mines to eliminate rogue robots. The game is set in a maze-like, zero-gravity environment, featuring full 360-degree movement in three-dimensional space. This immersive, omnidirectional combat style sets it apart from traditional shooters. It adds cerebral navigation and mixed with intense combat, further enhanced by the game's impressive 3D graphics for the time. The game also features multiplayer mode where players can duel in fierce space dogfights. Celebrated for its innovative gameplay and immersive 3D environments, Descent has left an undeniable footprint in the first-person shooter genre. If you're a fan of fast-paced, immersive shooters like Doom or complex, strategic gameplay like in Portal, you'll be a fan of Descent.

game.description: Super Paper Mario is a unique blend of platformer and RPG, published by Nintendo and developed by Intelligent Systems for the Wii console. Released in 2007, the game deviates from the traditional turn-based combat of its precursors, instead adopting real-time gameplay in a unique 2D/3D dynamic. In Super Paper Mario, players assume the roles of Mario, Princess Peach, Bowser, and Luigi as they quest to rescue the universe from the nefarious Count Bleck. The storyline requires players to flip between dimensions, employ character-specific abilities, and engage in puzzle-solving to navigate through the chapters. Being a Paper Mario game, it retains RPG aspects by allowing characters to level up their hit points and attack power through earning points by defeating enemies or completing certain tasks. Its novel fusion of genres coupled with its quirky humor and narrative depth makes it a standout entry in the Paper Mario series. Super Paper Mario has been praised for its inventive gameplay, charming graphics, and engaging storytelling. If you're a fan of inventive platformers like Fez, or humor-packed RPG games like the South Park: The Stick of Truth, you'll be a fan of Super Paper Mario.

game.description: Jeanne d'Arc is a tactical role-playing video game developed by Level-5 and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation Portable. Released in 2006, the game reimagines the historical tale of Joan of Arc and puts players in the helm of a young girl named Jeanne. Set against the backdrop of a fantastical version of the Hundred Years' War, the game pits Jeanne and her comrades against demonic forces. The gameplay is characterized by turn-based combat on grid-based maps, in which strategy and tactics play a major role. The game's "Burning Aura" feature, which allows characters to gain special abilities when they stand in the aura of a fallen enemy, adds a unique layer to the strategical aspect. Jeanne d'Arc also features a skill-binding system, which lets players customize each character's skills based on equipped items. Praised for its engaging storyline, character development, and richly detailed graphics, Jeanne d'Arc seamlessly blends historical narrative with fantasy RPG elements. If you're a fan of strategic role-playing games like Fire Emblem or Final Fantasy Tactics, you'll definitely be a fan of Jeanne d'Arc.

game.description: Earthworm Jim is a side-scrolling platformer game developed by Shiny Entertainment and published by Playmates Interactive Entertainment. Released in 1994, Earthworm Jim places players in control of an anthropomorphic earthworm who dons a super-powered suit and fights off a range of eccentric enemies on his adventures. As Earthworm Jim, players leap, run, and gun their way across a variety of unique and distinctive levels, each loaded with quirky enemies, puzzles, and hidden items. With its run and gun style of gameplay mixed with elements of a platformer, Earthworm Jim offers a unique combination of challenge and humor as players negotiate through a world filled with mad cows, underwater levels, and bungee-jumping battles. Its irreverent sense of humor, cartoonish, yet detailed, visuals, and imaginative level designs set it apart in its era. Earthworm Jim is celebrated for its diverse gameplay, satirical humor, and iconic character design. If you're a fan of platforming games with a twist like Rayman or humorous adventure games like Psychonauts, you'll be a fan of Earthworm Jim.

game.description: Yoshi's Island DS is a platform game developed by Artoon and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo DS. A sequel to the much-beloved Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island, the game was released in 2006 and once again puts players in control of Yoshi who is tasked with safely escorting baby versions of famous Nintendo characters across various levels. The gameplay in Yoshi's Island DS primarily involves platforming, puzzle-solving, and combat encounters. Each baby character grants Yoshi unique abilities allowing for varied gameplay within the level design. For instance, baby Mario gives Yoshi speed, baby Peach allows flight, and baby Donkey Kong adds strength. The game's art style, evocative of a child's crayon drawings, further sets it apart, giving it a charming, playful aesthetic. Yoshi's Island DS has been praised for its innovative use of the dual screens of the Nintendo DS, challenging platforming sequences, and the compelling use of different baby characters. If you're a fan of inventive platforming games like Super Mario World or Kirby's Epic Yarn, you'll be a fan of Yoshi's Island DS.

game.description: The Witcher is an action role-playing game developed by CD Projekt Red and published by Atari. Released in 2007, the game follows the compelling story of Geralt of Rivia, a professional monster hunter, or Witcher, with enhanced abilities and a half-hearted amnesia problem as he embarks on a perilous journey in a dark fantasy world. The Witcher's gameplay involves quest completion, monster battling, and story shaping through the decisions made by the player. Players can customize Geralt's abilities to suit their playstyle and explore the morally ambiguous universe inspired by Andrzej Sapkowski's novels, filled with complex characters, thrilling plot twists, and gritty undertones. The game's standout features include its dynamic combat system, mature themes, intricate narrative, ethical decision-making consequences and depth of character progression. The Witcher swiftly gained praise for its immersive narrative and the extensive freedom given to players in shaping the game's world and story. If you're a fan of dark-fantasy RPGs like Dragon Age: Origins or complex action-adventure games like the Mass Effect series, you'll love The Witcher.

game.description: Resident Evil 3: Nemesis is a survival horror game developed by Capcom and is the third installment in the Resident Evil series. Released in 1999, it returns players to the zombie-infested Raccoon City as Jill Valentine, a former S.T.A.R.S officer, who is trying to escape the city while being pursued by an intimidating bio-organic weapon called the Nemesis. The gameplay in Resident Evil 3 continues the series' combination of action, exploration, and puzzle-solving, but with a new emphasis on evading enemy attacks. An innovative addition is the dodge mechanic, which allows players to avoid incoming attacks, adding an extra layer of strategy to combat. The game also introduces the nemesis system: a formidable, nearly invincible enemy that pursues the player relentlessly throughout the game, adding a persistent element of tension. This blend of survival horror and action, along with the constant threat of Nemesis, result in a game that skillfully balances fear and excitement. Resident Evil 3: Nemesis has been praised for its tense atmosphere, engaging gameplay, and its iconic titular antagonist. If you're a fan of survival horror games like Silent Hill or Dead Space, you'll be a fan of Resident Evil 3: Nemesis.

game.description: Dead Space 3 is a survival horror video game developed by Visceral Games and published by Electronic Arts. Inviting players into an icy and horrifying world, this 2013 release is the third installment in the Dead Space series. The story continues with protagonist Isaac Clarke, this time pairing him with Sergeant John Carver for a cooperative game mode. They're sent on a mission to the hostile ice planet of Tau Volantis, believed to be the source of the Necromorph outbreak - reanimated human corpses transformed by an alien virus. The game continues its predecessors' tradition of strategic dismemberment, while adding new gameplay elements such as the ability to craft weapons and the necessity to seek warmth to survive the harsh environment. Its interstellar locales range from flotillas of wrecked and salvageable starships to the challenging terrains of Tau Volantis, heightening the fright with the addition of environmental hazards. Known for its excellent sound design, eerie ambience, and the desperate quest for survival against terrifying odds, Dead Space 3 has left an indelible mark on the genre. If you're a fan of immersive horror games like Resident Evil or Alien: Isolation, you'll be a fan of Dead Space 3.

game.description: Super Metroid is an action-adventure game launched in 1994, developed and published by Nintendo for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System. In this thrilling installment, players assume the role of Samus Aran, a galactic bounty hunter, as she ventures onto the planet Zebes to recover a baby Metroid stolen by the evil Ridley. The gameplay of Super Metroid is renowned for its non-linear exploration and unique atmosphere, allowing players to venture through a vast, interconnected world, discover power-ups that enhance Samus' suit, and ultimately unravel the game's sprawling map. The game's use of atmospheric storytelling, eerie audio design, and moody visuals create an immersive alien world filled with secrets, dangers, and intrigue. Furthermore, Super Metroid's innovative design has been influential in shaping the 'Metroidvania' genre, a style of action-adventure gameplay featuring expansive world maps, progression gated by power ups, and backtracking. Super Metroid has been widely praised for its engaging gameplay, rich atmosphere, and pioneering game design. If you're a fan of exploration-heavy games like Hollow Knight and Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, you'll be a fan of Super Metroid.

game.description: The Pathless is an action-adventure video game developed by Giant Squid and published by Annapurna Interactive. Launched in 2020, the game places players in the role of the Hunter, a master archer set on a mystical island. The Hunter's mission is to lift a curse of darkness that grips the world. In The Pathless, players traverse an open world, solving puzzles to unlock new areas and engaging in epic battles with corrupted spirits. The game distinguishes itself through its unique movement mechanics - there is no traditional walking or running. Instead, players glide through forests and across grasslands by shooting targets with their bow to maintain momentum. The stunning open world is fully explorable, inviting players to delve into its hidden depths to reveal its secrets. The narrative unfolds through environmental storytelling and encounters with corrupted spirits, adding a level of intrigue and mystery to the atmospheric world. The Pathless has been lauded for its fluid movement mechanics, breathtaking world, and the fusion of puzzles with action-adventure gaming. If you're a fan of explorative games such as Journey or the puzzle-solving and action of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, you'll be a fan of The Pathless.

game.description: Shadow Hearts: Covenant, also known as Shadow Hearts II, is a role-playing video game developed by Nautilus and published by Aruze in Japan and Midway in other countries. As the direct sequel to Shadow Hearts, the story continues the adventures of Yuri Hyuga, an anti-hero with the power to morph into different monsters, and Karin Koenig, a German lieutenant. Set against the backdrop of World War I, the narrative is steeped in historical events and legends abound with supernatural elements. Unique in its gameplay is the innovative “Judgment Ring” system, where players must hit certain areas on a spinning wheel to execute attacks or spells successfully, adding an exciting element of skill and timing. The game also provides the freedom to explore both real and fantastical versions of various locations in Europe and Asia, adding a touch of realism and dreamlike quality to the fantastical plot. Shadow Hearts: Covenant has been highly acclaimed for its creative blend of historical and fantastical narratives, diverse array of characters and unique battle system. If you're a fan of engaging RPG games with a historical setting like Final Fantasy Tactics or Valkyria Chronicles, then you'll also enjoy Shadow Hearts: Covenant.

game.description: Assassin's Creed III is an action-adventure game developed by Ubisoft Montreal and published by Ubisoft. The open-world setting allows players to explore early American cities like Boston and New York, along with large tracts of wilderness. As with previous titles in the series, players can undertake historical missions involving real-life figures and events but Assassin’s Creed III notably enhanced these with a greater emphasis on stealth and parkour mechanisms. The multilayered story delves into the dark underbelly of secret societies and their control over historical events, retaining the franchise's trademark fusion of history and fantasy. Assassin's Creed III has been praised for its ambitious narrative, period-authenticity, and diverse gameplay mechanics. If you're a fan of historically rich, stealth-action games like Shadow of Mordor or the Hitman series, you'll be a fan of Assassin's Creed III.

The game is known for its brutal combat system that uses both physical and magical attacks, and for its dramatic use of QTE (Quick Time Events) in cinematically showing the killing of characters. The game also introduces a number of new play elements, such as Kratos's ability to ride enemies and use them to attack other foes. The game is notable for its compelling narrative, stunning visuals and intense, visceral combat. The player's use of Kratos's steadfast rage and weapon skills to annihilate enemies and destruct environments remains one of the most remarkable features of the game. God of War III has been heralded for its cinematic quality and an immersive storyline that brings the epic trilogy to a thrilling conclusion. If you're a fan of action-adventure games like Devil May Cry or Bayonetta, you'll be a fan of God of War III.

game.description: Gauntlet: Legends is an action-adventure Dungeons and Dragons-inspired game developed by Atari Games and published by Midway Games. Boasting release in 1998, Gauntlet: Legends catapults players into the heart of a magical fantasy realm. Players choose one of four classic character types: Warrior, Valkyrie, Archer, or Wizard, each providing varying combat styles and abilities. The narrative unfolds as these heroes attempt to save the land and its inhabitants from impending doom by completing quests and recovering shards from a shattered magical rune stone. The gameplay embraces cooperative team strategy, hack-and-slash combat, puzzle-solving, exploration, and dungeon-crawling in varying proportions. As each quest is completed, players can strengthen their chosen avatars by accumulating experience points and acquiring new abilities. With an impressive selection of enemies and bosses, this game offers a diverse array of multi-level dungeons and environments that keep the action fresh and intriguing. Gauntlet: Legends has been admired for its captivating, cooperative multiplayer experience and classic arcade style gaming. If you're a fan of multiplayer action games like Diablo or Baldurs Gate, you'll be a fan of Gauntlet: Legends.

game.description: Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light is an action-adventure game developed by Crystal Dynamics and published by Square Enix. The gameplay blends together puzzle-solving elements and treasure hunting, against the backdrop of visually impressive, maze-like environments. The game is presented in an isometric viewpoint, enhancing spelunking and combat with some tactical advantages, and introducing co-op specific mechanics, making the cooperative experience genuinely collaborative, rather than simply parallel play. Its intricate puzzles, a vast range of weaponry, and engaging boss battles provide for a rich gaming experience. Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light has been lauded for its immersive game design, exciting co-op play, and successful departure from traditional Tomb Raider gameplay. If you're a fan of cooperative action-adventure games like Uncharted: Drake's Fortune or the Temple of Osiris, you'll be a fan of Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light.

game.description: Lollipop Chainsaw is an action-adventure game developed by Grasshopper Manufacture and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment. Launched in 2012, it puts players into the cheerleading boots of Juliet Starling, a zombie-slaying cheerleader with a charm as deadly as her chainsaw. Set in the fictional San Romero High School, the game combines hack and slash gameplay with other elements like rhythm and side-scrolling. Juliet must save her high school, and the world, from a horde of crazed zombies unleashed by a goth classmate. With each swing of her chainsaw, she uncovers the mystery behind the outbreak and learns powerful combos to crush the undead horde. Along the way, she can find special lollipops to restore her health, hence the game's quirky title. Lollipop Chainsaw's unique blend of comedy, action, and over-the-top bloodshed, combined with its distinctive cheerleader protagonist, gives it a memorable appeal. Its vibrant comic book-style graphics, coupled with a pumping rock 'n roll soundtrack, add to the overall manic experience. If you're a fan of action-packed hack and slash games like Bayonetta or comedic horror games like Dead Rising, you'll be a fan of Lollipop Chainsaw.

Astral Bot: Rescue Mission has won hearts for its charming world, innovative use of VR, and engaging gameplay. If you're a fan of platform games like Super Mario Odyssey or inventive VR titles like Beat Saber, you'll be a fan of Astro Bot: Rescue Mission.

game.description: Devil May Cry 3: Dante's Awakening is an action-adventure hack and slash video game developed and published by Capcom. Unveiled in 2005, it unfolds the compellingly dark origin story of Dante, the brash protagonist of the series, and his vendetta against his twin brother Vergil in a twisted demonic world. Players assume the role of Dante, as they combat demons with his signature "stylish" combat involving flashy melee and ranged attacks. The game is characterized by its combo-heavy combat system, fast pace, and the difficulty level. Devil May Cry 3 makes unique use of a 'style' system allowing players to specialize in different tactics such as swordsmanship or gunnery, leading to varied gameplay experiences. Yet another exciting feature is its 'Devil Trigger' power-up mode, transforming Dante into a demon for boosted power and speed, enriching the adrenaline-infused gameplay. The narrative weaves into gameplay, successfully establishing Dante's character and bitingly rivalry with Vergil. The game is recognized for its immersive storytelling, breathtaking visuals, compelling characters, and innovative combat system. If you're a fan of fast-paced, action-packed games like Bayonetta or God of War, you'll be a fan of Devil May Cry 3: Dante's Awakening.

game.description: Yakuza, also known as Ryū ga Gotoku, is an action-adventure game developed by SEGA's CS1 Team. The game, released in 2005, thrusts players into the underworld of Tokyo's crime syndicates. Players assume the role of Kazuma Kiryu, a yakuza member who takes the fall for his boss's death and emerges from a ten-year prison sentence only to find his family in shambles and a mystery to unravel. Throughout the game, players navigate the fictional district of Kamurocho, engaging in street fights with different combat styles and engaging in various minigames like karaoke, batting cages, and more. Further depth is added by a rich narrative laden with plot-twists, betrayals, and emotional confrontations. Yakuza has been appreciated for its theatrical storytelling, atmospheric city environment, and a compelling blend of action and exploration. Its combat system builds on the player's progression and is equal parts brutal and strategic. If you're a fan of narrative-driven, action-heavy games like the Sleeping Dogs or Grand Theft Auto series, you'll be a fan of Yakuza.

game.description: Stories Untold is an episodic horror adventure game developed by No Code and published by Devolver Digital. Released in 2017, it features a unique blend of genres and styles across four chilling narrative episodes that intertwine into meta-commentary on methodical puzzle-solving & interaction with technology. The game takes players on a suspense-filled journey as they experience a series of seemingly unrelated yet eerie ambient adventures ranging from a text adventure to a lab experiment and beyond. Each episode has its distinct mechanics and unique aesthetics, making for an unsettling and immersive experience in the vein of 80s horror anthology series. While primarily text-driven, the game also includes real-time 3D environments to ensure a genuine feeling of unease and tension as players unravel the mystery. The game has received significant praise for its macabre narrative, high tension levels, and unique approach to storytelling. Its multidimensional gameplay features an intriguing combination of text adventures, first-person exploration, and interactive fiction. If youre a fan of atmospheric horror adventures like The Dark Pictures Anthology or narrative-driven games like Until Dawn or Oxenfree, youll be captivated by Stories Untold.

game.description: Amnesia: A Machine for Pigs is a survival horror game developed by The Chinese Room and published by Frictional Games. In this chilling sequel to the original Amnesia: The Dark Descent, players take on the role of a wealthy industrialist named Oswald Mandus who wakes up from a fever-stricken sleep plagued by visions of a dystopian machine-filled future. The gameplay in A Machine for Pigs combines exploration and puzzle-solving in a deeply atmospheric setting. Unlike most survival horror games, players are discouraged from facing the horrors directly and instead must rely on stealth and evasion. The advanced physics system lets players interact realistically with the environment, while the sanity mechanic portrays the protagonist's increasing dread. Set in the dark underbelly of London in 1899, the narrative explores themes of industrialism, capitalism, and human nature. Amnesia: A Machine for Pigs has been praised for its atmospheric narrative, thought-provoking themes, and the fear that it masterfully instills in players. If you're a fan of survival horror games like Outlast or psychological thrillers like Soma, you'll be a fan of Amnesia: A Machine for Pigs.

game.description: Mirror's Edge Catalyst is an action-adventure platformer developed by EA DICE and published by Electronic Arts. Released in 2016, it reboots the groundbreaking parkour-themed franchise, as players return to the shoes of Faith Connors, a runner navigating the dystopian cityscape of Glass. Unlike its predecessor, Catalyst features a large-scale open world, allowing players to freely explore districts, undertake missions and engage in environmental puzzles. Players must make precise jumps, slides, and wall-runs to traverse the city, often whilst evading enemies or attempting high-speed heists. The game also introduces a multiplayer feature, where players can leave behind 'runner tags' for others to discover. Combat is modified to focus on Faith's parkour movements, with the aim of keeping her momentum intact. Mirror's Edge Catalyst has been lauded for its expansive world, fluid gameplay, and the unique thrill of first-person parkour in an urban dystopia. If you're a fan of the free-roaming action found in Infamous series or the high-intensity parkour of Assassin's Creed, you're likely to be a fan of Mirror's Edge Catalyst.

game.description: Thomas Was Alone is a minimalist indie puzzle-platformer developed and published by Mike Bithell Games. Released in 2012, players are immersed in the world of artificial intelligences, personified as different geometric shapes, with the game telling the story of their journey to becoming sentient and their quest for purpose and identity. The protagonist is Thomas, a simple red rectangle with a curious nature. Thomas Was Alone stands out with its unique narrative style, drawing players in with clever storytelling delivered by a thought-provoking narrator. The gameplay involves navigating the characters through various fields by exploiting their unique abilities, such as floating on water, or jumping heights, to solve puzzles. Each level is carefully designed to challenge the player's problem-solving skills and adaptability. Aside from its intriguing puzzles and gameplay, Thomas Was Alone is lauded for its atmospheric soundtrack and its ability to evoke emotional connections to its simple, geometric characters. It is a testament to the power of storytelling within games. If you're a fan of narrative-driven puzzle games like Limbo or Braid, you'll be drawn into the geometric world of Thomas Was Alone.

game.description: Rogue Legacy 2 is an intriguing roguelike platformer developed and published by Cellar Door Games. Released in 2022 as a follow-up to the original highly acclaimed title, the game brings players back to a mystical realm, but with a delightful twist. In Rogue Legacy 2, you aren’t just a hero; you're a lineage, with unique descendants born from your successes and failures. The gameplay features a mix of platforming, exploration, and roguelike mechanics. Players traverse deadly, procedurally generated castles, battling an array of creatures and bosses while gathering gold for upgrades. Each time your character dies, their child takes over, carrying remnants of their legacy — these heirs are not simple clones but come with unique traits and disabilities that affect gameplay, adding an intriguing layer to the story and strategy. Rogue Legacy 2 has been lauded for its ingenious evolution of roguelike mechanics, quirky humor, upgraded biomes, and the engaging concept of lineage. If you're a fan of addictive roguelike games like Dead Cells or The Binding of Isaac, you'll certainly appreciate Rogue Legacy 2.

game.description: Shadow Warrior is a first-person shooter game developed by 3D Realms and published by GT Interactive. Released in 1997, it introduces players to the vibrant yet dangerous mythological landscapes of Japan, through the character of Lo Wang, a former bodyguard for the powerful Zilla Corporation. The gameplay in Shadow Warrior balances swift action with strategic fighting, combining traditional gunplay with unique weapons such as the uzi, sticky bombs, and even a revered katana. Players traverse a rich environment teeming with both human and demonic enemies, whilst uncovering secret areas and special abilities. Furthermore, Shadow Warrior is well-known for its incorporation of East Asian mythology, as players can encounter and defeat various kinds of mythical demons and monsters. The game's combination of classic first-person shooter elements along with distinctive graphics and humor sets it apart in the gaming scene. If you're a fan of fast-paced, action-packed first-person shooter games like Duke Nukem or Serious Sam, you'll be a fan of Shadow Warrior.

game.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 is a first-person shooter game developed by Infinity Ward and Sledgehammer Games, and published by Activision. Released in 2011 as the third installment in the Modern Warfare saga, it continues the story of an intense global conflict between the United States and a Russian Federation invasion force. Players are introduced to a variety of characters, both new and returning, and thrown into varying roles that span the globe from New York City to Paris and Berlin. Gameplay remains rooted in the series' high-octane, cinematic gunfights but pushes the envelope with more dynamic, wide-ranging battles and a larger, destructible environment that intensifies the sense of realism. Multiplayer modes are a main draw, with new gameplay mechanics, a vast array of weapons to choose from, and extensive customizability options. One standout feature is the new Survival Mode, where players fight off endless waves of enemies, proving their endurance. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 has been lauded for its intense action sequences, robust multiplayer experiences, and its continuing saga of global conflict. If you're a fan of action-packed shooter games like Battlefield or Medal of Honor, you'll be a fan of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
answers: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III

game.description: Child of Light is a mesmerizing role-playing game developed by Ubisoft Montreal and published by Ubisoft. Released in 2014, players embark on a fairy tale adventure in the shoes of Aurora, a young girl from Austria who wakes up in the mythical land of Lemuria. The aim is to defeat the dark Queen Umbra who has stolen the sun, moon, and stars. Gameplay includes traditional RPG elements with players engaging in platforming exploration of beautifully hand-drawn landscapes and participating in turn-based combat with creatures they encounter on their journey. The game also features a cooperative multiplayer mode where a second player can control Aurora's firefly companion, Igniculus. What sets Child of Light apart is its visual aesthetic which draws heavily from storybook illustrations and its atmospheric score. The dialogue and narrative presented in rhyming verse also lend a unique charm. Child of Light has been lauded for its enchanting visuals, engaging combat system, and a heartfelt story that is rarely seen in gaming. If you're a fan of visually striking RPGs like Ori and the Blind Forest or innovative narrative games like Valiant Hearts: The Great War, you'll be a fan of Child of Light.

game.description: A Plague Tale: Innocence is an atmospheric action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio and published by Focus Home Interactive. Set in 14th century France during the midst of the Black Plague, you'll take on the roles of siblings Amicia and Hugo De Rune. Seeking to unveil the dark secret of the plague, you must survive against overwhelming odds including swarms of disease-ridden rats. The gameplay combines stealth, puzzle-solving, and environmental utilisation, requiring players to distract or manipulate masses of rat swarms in order to progress or eliminate enemies. As you explore the grim medieval landscapes, the relationship between Amicia and Hugo deepens, creating a compelling and emotional narrative at the heart of this bleak and tense world. A Plague Tale: Innocence has been widely praised for its intense storytelling, immersive environments, atmospheric music, and the use of the rat swarms as a unique gameplay mechanic. If you're a fan of narrative-driven adventure games like The Last of Us and Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons, you'll be a fan of A Plague Tale: Innocence.

Released in 1988, the game takes players on an adventurous journey with the beloved character Mario across eight distinct kingdoms to rescue Princess Toadstool from the villainous Bowser and his offspring, the Koopalings. Each kingdom offers a variety of levels with unique landscapes and challenges. In an innovative twist, Mario acquires special suits such as the Frog Suit, Tanooki Suit, and the iconic Raccoon Suit, each granting unique abilities that invigorate gameplay. Players navigate through the levels by running, jumping, flying, swimming, and battling myriad enemies while also finding hidden areas and power-ups. The game introduced several new elements and power-ups that became staples of the series, like the Super Leaf and the Goomba Shoe. Super Mario Bros. 3 is renowned for its sprawling world, imaginative level design, enhanced game mechanics, and memorable soundtrack, setting a new standard for what platform games could offer. If you're a fan of platformer games like Sonic the Hedgehog or Donkey Kong Country, you'll be a fan of Super Mario Bros. 3.

game.description: Helltaker is a free-to-play adventure puzzle game created by Polish developer Łukasz Piskorz, also known as vanripper. Released in May 2020, the game follows the journey of the Helltaker, a man journeying through Hell to create a harem of demon girls. Players guide Helltaker through a series of increasingly challenging levels, where the objective is to strategically navigate and manipulate the environment to reach and conquer the demoness of each level within a limited number of moves. The gameplay is enriched with dialogue interactions, unique character designs, and intricate puzzles encompassing the theme of Hell. Each character possesses distinct personalities and roles, adding layers to the narrative. The game is also noted for its upbeat, jazz-inspired soundtrack that intertwines with its dynamic puzzle gameplay, creating immersive gaming experience. Helltaker has received praise for its clever puzzle mechanics, distinctive art style, captivating characters, and its satirical humor. If you're a fan of challenging puzzle games like Baba is You or engaging adventure games like Undertale, you'll be a fan of Helltaker.

game.description: The Curse of Monkey Island is an adventure game developed and published by LucasArts in 1997. In the third installment of the Monkey Island series, players step into the buckled shoes of Guybrush Threepwood, a wannabe pirate tasked with breaking a malicious curse and rescuing his love, Elaine Marley, from the clutches of the undead pirate LeChuck. The game is bursting with signature humor and eccentric characters that make the Monkey Island games a delight. Incorporating a point-and-click interface, the gameplay sees players solving puzzles interactively and navigating through beautifully drawn, Caribbean-inspired locales. Dialogue sequences, often dotted with comedy, are integral in solving the game's imaginative puzzles and push the story forward. The Curse of Monkey Island also introduced a new verve to the series with its hand-drawn animation and full voice acting that brought the caricature-like characters to life. The game has bagged praises for its clever puzzles, catchy music, and refreshing visual style. If you're a fan of comedic adventure games like Day of The Tentacle or King's Quest, you'll be a fan of The Curse of Monkey Island.

game.description: Dead Rising 3 is an action-adventure, survival horror game developed by Capcom Vancouver and published by Microsoft Studios. Released in 2013, Dead Rising 3 thrusts players into the zombie-infested city of Los Perdidos, California, as they take up the role of mechanic Nick Ramos who must find a way to escape the city before a military strike wipes it off the map. In Dead Rising 3, players can use anything they find as a weapon, create combo weapons and vehicles, and team up with other survivors to fight off hordes of zombies. The game primarily focuses on exploration and scavenging, with the entire city open to exploration from the beginning, and the clock ticking towards the devastating military strike. This adds a real sense of urgency to the game and forces players to make strategic decisions about their survival plans. One of the key features of Dead Rising 3 is its ability to handle thousands of zombies on screen at once, pushing the action and intensity to new heights. Dead Rising 3 has been praised for enhancing its sandbox style gameplay, its dark humor, and consistent thrill of zombie combat. If you're a fan of zombie survival games like Left 4 Dead or State of Decay, you'll be a fan of Dead Rising 3.

game.description: We Happy Few is a dark, dystopian action-adventure game developed by Compulsion Games and published by Gearbox Publishing. Released initially in 2016 in early access and subsequently as a full launch in 2018, it burrows its players into an alternative 1960s England where society is hooked on a drug named Joy to forget a traumatic past. The game allows players to control three distinct characters, each with their own narratives and view on the surreal world. We Happy Few intertwines gameplay with a compelling narrative as players employ stealth, combat, and navigation to traverse a series of procedurally generated locales. The citizens who catch players not adhering to their Joy-infused routines will turn hostile, adding a distinct layer of tangible tension to exploration. The game encourages experimentation and allows multiple approaches towards objectives, crafting a unique experience for each player, marking its edge in the genre. We Happy Few has been praised for its captivating storytelling, atmospheric world-building, and its clever blend of survival and roguelike elements. If you're a fan of dark, narrative-driven games like Bioshock or Dishonored with a tinge of survival horror games like Outlast, you'll be a fan of We Happy Few.

game.description: Lego Island is an action-adventure computer game developed and published by Mindscape. Released in 1997, it whisks players away to a vibrant, open-world, fully interactive island made entirely of Lego bricks. Players take on the roles of various Lego minifigures, including a pizza delivery boy, a police officer, and a skater. Each character offers different gameplay experiences, enabling players to explore Lego Island in various ways. The core gameplay revolves around performing tasks and mini-games, ranging from delivering pizzas to policing the island, in a sandbox environment. The game is notable for being the first to be based on the Lego property, setting a precedent for a long line of successful Lego-themed games. Lego Islands non-linear gameplay, combined with the charm of the Lego universe, made for a unique blend of fun and creativity. This game pioneered the concept of interactive Lego video games, and its combination of open-world exploration with light-hearted mini-games set it apart. If you're a fan of charming, sandbox-style games like Animal Crossing or the later Lego video games like Lego Star Wars or Lego City Undercover, you'll be a fan of Lego Island.

game.description: BMX XXX is an unusual action sports video game that was developed by Z-Axis and published by Acclaim Entertainment. Released in 2002, the game amused and shocked in equal measure with its risqué humor and BMX tricks. Based around the world of BMX stunts, players control a BMX biker with more than 2,000 different tricks in their repertoire. The central plot is humorous and racy, with bikers completing odd jobs around three locations: Las Vegas, Bronx and Launch Pad 69. Each job reward players with cash that can be used to unlock more difficult stunts and gain adult content. Unique to the console sports game genre at the time, BMX XXX featured riders performing risky feats amidst raunchy, adult themes including nudity and crude humor, shaping it into a controversial but innovative title of its time. Its gameplay tries for a blend of Tony Hawk's Pro Skater's trick-based combo system mechanics while introducing its original, outrageous storyline. If you're a fan of off-the-wall titles like Goat Simulator or hilarious, edgy humor like in Leisure Suit Larry games, you'll be a fan of BMX XXX.

The game has been revered for its deep survival mechanics, intense combat, and the emphasis on strategy and community building. If you're a fan of survival games like The Last of Us or Dead Island, you'll be a fan of State of Decay.

game.description: Outlast 2 is a first-person survival horror game developed and published by Red Barrels. Released in 2017, players are plunged into the depths of rural Arizona's horrors as they control investigative journalist Blake Langermann, who, along with his wife Lynn, are investigating the murder of a pregnant woman. The game's progression primarily involves running, hiding, and sneaking past deadly threats, as fighting back is not a primary option. However, players can use a camera with night vision to navigate through the game's extremely dark environment. In contrast to the first Outlast's asylum setting, Outlast 2's story is set in a variety of outdoor and indoor places, from farmland and forests to schools and houses, enhancing the horror experience. The central narrative focuses on themes of corruption, fanaticism, and the darkest sides of human nature, which are conveyed through unconventional flashbacks, disturbing documents and chilling encounters. Outlast 2 is praised for its suspenseful atmosphere, terrifying enemies and its masterful use of darkness and sound to create pure fear. If you're a fan of survival horror games like Amnesia: The Dark Descent or Alien: Isolation, you'll be a fan of Outlast 2.

game.description: Pong is an arcade game developed and published by Atari, which was released in 1972 and quickly become one of the most famous games in the world. As one of the earliest arcade video games, Pong introduced the mass market to the joys of virtual tennis, setting the stage for what would become the multibillion-dollar video game industry. The game is simplicity itself - players maneuver a blip (representing a tennis paddle) up and down the left or right side of the screen, bouncing a small square (the tennis ball) back and forth in an attempt to score against the other player. Despite its minimalist graphics and gameplay by today's standards, Pong was revolutionary in its time and still holds atmospheric appeal. It was incredibly influential, setting the groundwork for the development of the video game industry. Atari's release of Pong on a home console sparked enthusiasm for video games in households across the world, paving the way for today's popular home gaming systems. If you're a fan of classic arcade games like Space Invaders or Tetris, you'll appreciate the seminal Pong.
